guide: trades are returned most-recent-first. Each entry is a closed/realizing trade with the realized gain/loss on it. price is the execution (close) price. The window is a preset span (not an arbitrary date range); default is the last week. Paginate with cursor: pass next_cursor from the previous response; an empty next_cursor means there are no more trades. An empty trades list means there were no realized trades in the window - a valid result, not an error. Treat figures as informational, not a tax document or tax/performance advice.
